incident_text: A brick building partly collapsed after the earthquake. Bricks are lying across the street.

result.scene_summary: A severely damaged multi-story brick building with collapsed sections and debris on the street, surrounded by construction barriers and traffic signals, with other buildings and a distant skyscraper in the background.

observations.description: Significant damage to a brick building, including collapsed sections, exposed interior framing, and shattered windows.
Traffic light poles and street signs are visible near the damaged building.
Several vehicles are parked or visible on the street in the background.
A pile of brick rubble and construction debris is on the street, with an orange traffic cone and a green tarp visible.
Trees are visible in the background behind other buildings.
A sign with text "NO S" is partially visible on the ground near the debris.
